# Security policy

This is a static site, built from the `master` branch and served by GitHub Pages. Only the live site and `master` are maintained.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue. Email mmfuad01@gmail.com with:

- the affected page or file
- what the problem is and how to reproduce it

I'll get back to you as soon as I can.

Third-party services used by the site, such as Google Analytics, Google Fonts, and linked Google Drive files, are out of scope. Report issues with those to their providers.
